Select: chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie (EFO ID), indication_label (EFO term), max_phase_for_ind. Source: molecule_dictionary, compound_structures, drug_indication. Join: molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno. molecule_dictionary to drug_indication on molregno. Filter: molecule_dictionary.max_phase = 4. drug_indication.efo_term = 'cardiovascular disease'. Sort: chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie, indication_label, max_phase_for_ind ascending.
